subject: reasoning
question: All flowers are plants. Some plants are flowering plants. Which conclusion is logically valid?
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f36ecebb6f0a1c2bc591464e1abe7cc868eef095f3c8ed2abc46956bea2e20a0.png] 

Conclusions:

Option 1) No plants are flowers → Does not follow (As all flowers are plants. As whole flowers comes in plants, therefore it is false.)

Option 2) Some flowers are not plants → Does not follow (As all flowers are plants. As whole flowers comes in plants, therefore it is false.)

Option 3) Some plants are flowers → Follow (As all flowers are plants. As whole flowers comes in plants, therefore it is True.)

Option 4) All plants are flowers → Does not follow (As all flowers are plants. As whole flowers comes in plants, so it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Only conclusion 3 follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
